# Browser Dependencies

These unmodified, version-pinned browser bundles are served locally. No CDN
connection or package installation is required to play.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Planck | 1.5.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/planck@1.5.0/dist/planck.mjs | MIT; see planck.LICENSE |
| Lucide | 1.45.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@1.45.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js | ISC and included third-party notices; see lucide.LICENSE |

Planck supplies Orbit collision detection and continuous physics. The optional
Planck testbed and its stage-js peer are not used. Lucide supplies interface icons.
Keep each license file alongside its bundle when redistributing this project.
